reason: I'd use the free visit for sure and probably come back a few times if it's actually clean, since I'm always looking for an indoor spot when it's hot or rainy. The moms-group $8 morning rate is what makes it work for me, I'd rather bring the group than pay $13 a visit on my own.
objection: $13 a kid adds up fast when storytime at the library is free, and it sounds a bit Instagram for Salisbury. I need to see it's really clean and not just pretty.
would_change_my_mind: A solid moms-group deal I can organize for my group, plus seeing the place and the cleaning log in person on the free first visit.
